title: Tesla vs Waymo: The Robotaxi Number Nobody Talks About #shorts

scenes.text: Tesla's new robotaxi zone in San Antonio is four times bigger than Waymo's. So is Tesla winning?
On November ninth, Tesla opened about two hundred seventy square miles. Waymo, there since February, covers about sixty.
But count the cars. A public tracker counts over four thousand driverless Waymos, and six hundred sixty-six Teslas.
On launch morning, it saw zero Tesla robotaxis in San Antonio.
Waymo uses lidar, radar and cameras. Tesla bets on cameras and AI alone, a cheaper setup per car.
Bigger map, or more cars: who wins the robotaxi race? Tell me in the comments. Follow EV Drive.
